variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: VARIABLE creates a pointer. ! (store) writes to it, @ (fetch) reads from it.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
\ Everything is essentially a cell (word).
\ Manipulated on the data stack.
data_types.notes: Forth is typeless. Data is manipulated on the stack as cell-sized integers or addresses.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
1 2 +  \ Addition
3 4 *  \ Multiplication
5 2 /  \ Division
1 1 =  \ Equality (returns true/false flag)
operators.notes: Uses Reverse Polish Notation (RPN). Operators consume stack items and push the result.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.code:
: CHECK-ZERO ( n -- )
  0= IF
    ." It is zero"
  ELSE
    ." It is not zero"
  THEN ;
conditionals.notes: IF checks the top of the stack. ELSE is optional. Must end with THEN.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: DO ... LOOP executes from start (0) to limit (10). 'I' pushes the current loop index.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: BEGIN ... UNTIL loops until a true flag is on the stack. BEGIN ... WHILE ... REPEAT is also common.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions (words) are defined with ':' and end with ';'. The comment ( n -- n^2 ) describes stack effects.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.code:
CREATE MY-ARRAY 10 CELLS ALLOT

\ Store 42 in index 0
42 MY-ARRAY 0 CELLS + !
arrays.notes: No built-in array type. Memory is allocated using CREATE and ALLOT. Indexing is done manually with address math.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Dictionaries/maps are not built-in and must be implemented manually via linked lists or hash tables.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.code:
: SAFE-DIV ( n d -- res ) 
  DUP 0= IF 
    -22 THROW 
  ELSE 
    / 
  THEN ;

['] SAFE-DIV CATCH
error_handling.notes: THROW and CATCH (ANS Forth) provide exception handling by unwinding the return stack.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Forth provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Forth supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Forth provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Forth converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Forth represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Forth formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Forth branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Forth defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Forth iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Forth organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Forth stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Forth groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Forth tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Forth organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
